opportunities.title: Observe a project team
opportunities.description: Sample: see how a product team works before you commit.
opportunities.expected: Sit in on a team's meetings as a listener. You don't do project tasks.

opportunities.title: Agile foundations class
opportunities.description: Sample: a structured class on how agile teams work.
opportunities.expected: Attend weekly sessions and complete short exercises.

opportunities.title: Skills workshops
opportunities.description: Sample: try one skill at a time in a short session.
opportunities.expected: Join a single workshop and practice one skill.

opportunities.title: Apprentice on a project team
opportunities.description: Sample: real team experience on a product with a client.
opportunities.expected: Work on a product team for a full project phase and learn your role as you go.
opportunities.requirements: Commit to the full project phase

opportunities.title: Community events
opportunities.description: Sample: meet other members at open community sessions.
opportunities.expected: Join an event, listen and introduce yourself if you like.

opportunities.title: Community volunteer
opportunities.description: Sample: help run community activities for other members.
opportunities.expected: Help organize sessions and welcome new members.
opportunities.requirements: Some experience working with a team

opportunities.title: Role masterclass
opportunities.description: Sample: go deeper into one role with a guided class.
opportunities.expected: Attend sessions and complete a short project for your role.
opportunities.requirements: A course, bootcamp or project in this area

opportunities.title: Project co-lead
opportunities.description: Sample: help lead a project team in your role.
opportunities.expected: Guide a small team and coordinate with other leads.
opportunities.requirements: Experience working in a tech role

opportunities.title: Mentor
opportunities.description: Sample: support newer members with your experience.
opportunities.expected: Meet members one to one and answer their questions.
opportunities.requirements: Experience working in a tech role
